description: Search the EMA Article 57 database — every medicine with a valid marketing authorisation anywhere in the EEA (centrally, mutually-recognised, decentralised AND purely nationally authorised), one row per product x authorisation-country. Answers "which EEA countries is <product> authorised in", "who is the marketing-authorisation holder / pharmacovigilance system location for <product> in <country>", "which products does <company> hold in the EEA". Free-text query matches product name, active substance and holder name. Real offset+limit pagination with a total row count in the response — this is a 164k-row register, not a top-N sample.

country.description: Filter on authorisation country, e.g. "Germany", "France" (exact EMA country name; see ema_article57_dataset_info for the full list).

holder.description: Filter on marketing authorisation holder (substring match).

limit.description: Max rows to return, default 25, max 200.

query.description: Free text: product/brand name, active substance, or marketing-authorisation holder.

route.description: Filter on route of administration (substring match), e.g. "oral", "subcutaneous".

name: ema_article57_search
title: Ema Article57 Search
